description:
Suggest ontology-term candidates for a schema node from the public EMBL-EBI Ontology Lookup Service
(OLS). ADVISORY ONLY: this is a read-only search — it calls the external EBI OLS API and returns
ranked candidates, and it NEVER writes anything to the graph. In particular it never sets the
authoritative mapsTo mixin; binding a chosen term is a separate, explicit human-directed act via
bind_ontology_term (you name the exact node and the exact term IRI).

Provide either nodeId (the node's label is used as the query) or a raw label (optionally with a
description). Optionally restrict to a comma-separated list of ontologies (e.g. "efo,mondo,hp") and
cap the number of candidates. Each candidate carries { iri, curie, label, description, ontology, type }
in the relevance order OLS returns; the iri is what you would pass to bind_ontology_term.

description.description: Optional description text to refine the search ranking.

label.description: A raw term label to search for. Provide this OR nodeId.

nodeId.description: The schema node to ground. Its label is used as the query. Provide this OR label.

ontologies.description: Optional comma-separated ontology ids to restrict to, e.g. 'efo,mondo,hp'.

name: suggest_ontology_terms
title: Suggest Ontology Terms
